# sigil-ui full reference

package: sigil-ui (svelte peer ^5.0.0)
theme entry: sigil-ui/theme.css

## Components

### Button

Button with variant styling driven by data-variant and the --sig-* token contract. Forwards all native button attributes and events.

Props:
- variant ('primary' | 'secondary' | 'ghost' | 'danger', default 'primary'): Visual variant, rendered as data-variant on the element.
- class (ClassValue): Merged with the base class. Pass framework utility classes here.
- children (Snippet): Content rendered inside the element.
CSS classes: sig-btn
Data attributes: data-variant

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button } from 'sigil-ui'
</script>

<Button variant="secondary" onclick={save}>Save</Button>
```

### Badge

Inline status label. Tone is rendered as data-tone so any CSS framework can restyle it.

Props:
- tone ('neutral' | 'accent' | 'danger' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'info', default 'neutral'): Color tone, rendered as data-tone on the element.
- class (ClassValue): Merged with the base class. Pass framework utility classes here.
- children (Snippet): Content rendered inside the element.
CSS classes: sig-badge
Data attributes: data-tone

```svelte
<script>
  import { Badge } from 'sigil-ui'
</script>

<Badge tone="accent">beta</Badge>
```

### Switch

Toggle using role=switch and aria-checked. checked is bindable. Render state is exposed as data-state checked/unchecked.

Props:
- checked (boolean, bindable, default false): Bindable on/off state.
- class (ClassValue): Merged with the base class. Pass framework utility classes here.
- children (Snippet<[{ checked: boolean }]>): Custom content replacing the default thumb.
CSS classes: sig-switch, sig-switch-thumb
Data attributes: data-state, data-disabled

```svelte
<script>
  import { Switch } from 'sigil-ui'
  let on = $state(false)
</script>

<Switch bind:checked={on} aria-label="notifications" />
```

### Input

Styled native text input. value is bindable. Set aria-invalid for error state. Forwards all native input attributes.

Props:
- value (string | number, bindable): Bindable input value.
- type (string, default 'text'): Native input type.
- class (ClassValue): Merged with the base class. Pass framework utility classes here.
CSS classes: sig-input
Data attributes: 

```svelte
<script>
  import { Input } from 'sigil-ui'
  let name = $state('')
</script>

<Input bind:value={name} placeholder="Name" aria-label="Name" />
```

### Select

Styled native select with a chevron affordance. value is bindable. Options are provided as children.

Props:
- value (string, bindable): Bindable selected value.
- class (ClassValue): Merged with the base class. Pass framework utility classes here.
- children (Snippet): Content rendered inside the element.
CSS classes: sig-select-wrap, sig-select
Data attributes: 

```svelte
<script>
  import { Select } from 'sigil-ui'
  let plan = $state('free')
</script>

<Select bind:value={plan} aria-label="Plan">
  <option value="free">Free</option>
  <option value="pro">Pro</option>
</Select>
```

### Checkbox

Styled native checkbox. checked is bindable. Pair with a label element for an accessible name.

Props:
- checked (boolean, bindable, default false): Bindable checked state.
- class (ClassValue): Merged with the base class. Pass framework utility classes here.
CSS classes: sig-checkbox
Data attributes: 

```svelte
<script>
  import { Checkbox } from 'sigil-ui'
  let ok = $state(false)
</script>

<label><Checkbox bind:checked={ok} /> Accept terms</label>
```

### Avatar

Round avatar with image and initials fallback. Falls back automatically when the image fails to load.

Props:
- src (string): Image URL.
- alt (string): Accessible name for the avatar.
- fallback (string): Name used to derive up to two initials when no image is shown.
- class (ClassValue): Merged with the base class. Pass framework utility classes here.
CSS classes: sig-avatar, sig-avatar-img, sig-avatar-fallback
Data attributes: 

```svelte
<script>
  import { Avatar } from 'sigil-ui'
</script>

<Avatar src={user.avatar} alt={user.name} fallback={user.name} />
```

### Progress

Progress bar with role=progressbar and aria value wiring. Omit value for an indeterminate loading state. Honors reduced motion.

Props:
- value (number): Current value. Omit for indeterminate.
- max (number, default 100): Maximum value.
- label (string): Accessible label via aria-label.
- class (ClassValue): Merged with the base class. Pass framework utility classes here.
CSS classes: sig-progress, sig-progress-bar
Data attributes: data-indeterminate

```svelte
<script>
  import { Progress } from 'sigil-ui'
</script>

<Progress value={68} label="Upload progress" />
```

### Skeleton

Loading placeholder block with a pulse animation. aria-hidden. Honors reduced motion. Size it with class or style.

Props:
- class (ClassValue): Merged with the base class. Pass framework utility classes here.
CSS classes: sig-skeleton
Data attributes: 

```svelte
<script>
  import { Skeleton } from 'sigil-ui'
</script>

<Skeleton style="height: 2rem; width: 12rem" />
```

### Alert

Inline message with tone colors. danger and warning use role=alert, other tones use role=status.

Props:
- tone ('default' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger' | 'info', default 'default'): Color tone and live region role.
- title (string): Bold heading line.
- class (ClassValue): Merged with the base class. Pass framework utility classes here.
- children (Snippet): Content rendered inside the element.
CSS classes: sig-alert, sig-alert-title, sig-alert-body
Data attributes: data-tone

```svelte
<script>
  import { Alert } from 'sigil-ui'
</script>

<Alert tone="warning" title="Storage almost full">Free space is below 10%.</Alert>
```

### Separator

Horizontal or vertical rule. Decorative by default (role=none). Set decorative={false} to expose role=separator.

Props:
- orientation ('horizontal' | 'vertical', default 'horizontal'): Line direction.
- decorative (boolean, default true): When false, renders role=separator with aria-orientation.
- class (ClassValue): Merged with the base class. Pass framework utility classes here.
CSS classes: sig-separator
Data attributes: data-orientation

```svelte
<script>
  import { Separator } from 'sigil-ui'
</script>

<Separator />
```

### Stat

Dashboard metric: uppercase label, large value, optional signed delta colored by direction.

Props:
- label (string): Small uppercase label.
- value (string | number): Primary metric value.
- delta (number): Signed change. Positive renders up in success color, negative down in danger.
- deltaLabel (string): Unit suffix after delta, e.g. "%".
- class (ClassValue): Merged with the base class. Pass framework utility classes here.
- children (Snippet): Content rendered inside the element.
CSS classes: sig-stat, sig-stat-label, sig-stat-value, sig-stat-delta
Data attributes: data-dir

```svelte
<script>
  import { Stat } from 'sigil-ui'
</script>

<Stat label="Revenue" value="$48.2k" delta={12.5} deltaLabel="%" />
```

### Tooltip

Hover and focus tooltip. The children snippet receives props to spread on the trigger so aria-describedby is wired. Pure CSS show/hide.

Props:
- text (string): Tooltip text.
- side ('top' | 'bottom', default 'top'): Placement relative to the trigger.
- children (Snippet<[{ props: Record<string, string> }]>): Trigger element. Spread props onto it for aria-describedby.
- class (ClassValue): Merged with the base class. Pass framework utility classes here.
CSS classes: sig-tip-wrap, sig-tip
Data attributes: data-side

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tooltip, Button } from 'sigil-ui'
</script>

<Tooltip text="Save changes">
  {#snippet children({ props })}
    <Button {...props}>Save</Button>
  {/snippet}
</Tooltip>
```

### Card

Surface namespace: Root, Header, Title, Description, Content, Footer. The base unit for dashboard layouts.

Props:
- class (ClassValue): Accepted on every part.
- children (Snippet): Content rendered inside the element.
CSS classes: sig-card, sig-card-header, sig-card-title, sig-card-description, sig-card-content, sig-card-footer
Data attributes: 

```svelte
<script>
  import { Card, Stat } from 'sigil-ui'
</script>

<Card.Root>
  <Card.Header>
    <Card.Title>Traffic</Card.Title>
    <Card.Description>Last 30 days</Card.Description>
  </Card.Header>
  <Card.Content>
    <Stat label="Visits" value="128k" delta={8} deltaLabel="%" />
  </Card.Content>
</Card.Root>
```

### Tabs

Tabs namespace: Root (bindable value), List, Trigger, Content. Full keyboard support: arrows, Home, End, roving tabindex, automatic activation.

Props:
- value (string, bindable): Bindable selected tab on Tabs.Root. Trigger and Content take a value prop.
- class (ClassValue): Accepted on every part.
- children (Snippet): Content rendered inside the element.
CSS classes: sig-tabs, sig-tablist, sig-tab, sig-tabpanel
Data attributes: data-state

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tabs } from 'sigil-ui'
  let tab = $state('usage')
</script>

<Tabs.Root bind:value={tab}>
  <Tabs.List>
    <Tabs.Trigger value="usage">Usage</Tabs.Trigger>
    <Tabs.Trigger value="billing">Billing</Tabs.Trigger>
  </Tabs.List>
  <Tabs.Content value="usage">Usage panel</Tabs.Content>
  <Tabs.Content value="billing">Billing panel</Tabs.Content>
</Tabs.Root>
```

### Accordion

Accordion namespace: Root, Item (value), Trigger, Content. Buttons use aria-expanded and aria-controls, panels use role=region. Set multiple on Root to allow several open items.

Props:
- multiple (boolean, default false): Allow more than one open item on Accordion.Root.
- value (string): Item identifier on Accordion.Item.
- class (ClassValue): Accepted on every part.
- children (Snippet): Content rendered inside the element.
CSS classes: sig-accordion, sig-acc-item, sig-acc-heading, sig-acc-trigger, sig-acc-chevron, sig-acc-content
Data attributes: data-state

```svelte
<script>
  import { Accordion } from 'sigil-ui'
</script>

<Accordion.Root>
  <Accordion.Item value="a">
    <Accordion.Trigger>Section A</Accordion.Trigger>
    <Accordion.Content>Details for A.</Accordion.Content>
  </Accordion.Item>
</Accordion.Root>
```

### Dialog

Modal dialog namespace: Root (bindable open), Trigger, Portal, Overlay, Content, Title, Description, Close. Focus trap, Escape to close, scroll lock, focus restore, aria-labelledby/aria-describedby wiring. No external primitive library.

Props:
- open (boolean, bindable, default false): Bindable open state on Dialog.Root.
- class (ClassValue): Accepted on Trigger, Overlay, Content, Title, Description and Close.
- children (Snippet): Content rendered inside the element.
CSS classes: sig-dialog-trigger, sig-dialog-overlay, sig-dialog, sig-dialog-title, sig-dialog-description, sig-dialog-close
Data attributes: 

```svelte
<script>
  import { Dialog, Button } from 'sigil-ui'
  let open = $state(false)
</script>

<Dialog.Root bind:open>
  <Dialog.Trigger>Open</Dialog.Trigger>
  <Dialog.Portal>
    <Dialog.Overlay />
    <Dialog.Content>
      <Dialog.Title>Delete project</Dialog.Title>
      <Dialog.Description>This cannot be undone.</Dialog.Description>
      <Dialog.Close>Cancel</Dialog.Close>
    </Dialog.Content>
  </Dialog.Portal>
</Dialog.Root>
```

### Toaster

Toast system. Mount Toaster once, call toast.success() and friends from anywhere. Timed dismissal with hover and focus pause, action buttons, danger and warning use role=alert.

Props:
- position ('bottom-right' | 'bottom-left' | 'top-right' | 'top-left', default 'bottom-right'): Screen corner for the toast stack.
- class (ClassValue): Merged with the base class. Pass framework utility classes here.
CSS classes: sig-toaster, sig-toast, sig-toast-text, sig-toast-title, sig-toast-desc, sig-toast-action, sig-toast-close
Data attributes: data-position, data-tone

```svelte
<script>
  import { Toaster, toast, Button } from 'sigil-ui'
</script>

<Toaster />
<Button onclick={() => toast.success('Saved')}>Save</Button>
```

### PaneGroup

Resizable split panes (PaneGroup, Pane, PaneResizer). Pointer drag with pointer capture, keyboard resizing on the separator, min/max constraints, optional layout persistence via autoSaveId.

Props:
- direction ('horizontal' | 'vertical', default 'horizontal'): Split direction on PaneGroup.
- autoSaveId (string): Persist sizes to localStorage under this key on PaneGroup.
- keyboardStep (number, default 5): Percent moved per arrow key press on PaneGroup.
- defaultSize (number): Initial percent on Pane.
- minSize (number, default 0): Minimum percent on Pane.
- maxSize (number, default 100): Maximum percent on Pane.
- onLayout ((sizes: number[]) => void): Called on PaneGroup when a drag or key resize ends.
- class (ClassValue): Merged with the base class. Pass framework utility classes here.
- children (Snippet): Content rendered inside the element.
CSS classes: sig-pane-group, sig-pane, sig-pane-resizer, sig-pane-handle
Data attributes: data-direction, data-state, data-index

```svelte
<script>
  import { PaneGroup, Pane, PaneResizer } from 'sigil-ui'
</script>

<PaneGroup direction="horizontal" autoSaveId="dash" style="height: 24rem">
  <Pane defaultSize={30} minSize={20}>Sidebar</Pane>
  <PaneResizer />
  <Pane>Main</Pane>
</PaneGroup>
```

### Textarea

Styled native textarea with bindable value and invalid state.

Props:
- value (string, bindable, default ''): Bindable textarea value.
- invalid (boolean, default false): Sets aria-invalid and danger border.
- class (ClassValue): Merged with the base class. Pass framework utility classes here.
CSS classes: sig-textarea
Data attributes: data-invalid

```svelte
<script>
  import { Textarea } from 'sigil-ui'
  let bio = $state('')
</script>

<Textarea bind:value={bio} placeholder="Tell us about yourself" />
```

### RadioGroup

RadioGroup namespace: Root (bindable value, roving tabindex, arrow keys) and Item (role=radio, aria-checked).

Props:
- value (string, bindable, default ''): Bindable selected value on RadioGroup.Root.
- value (string): Required option value on RadioGroup.Item.
- disabled (boolean, default false): Disables the group or a single item.
- onValueChange ((value: string) => void): Called on selection change on RadioGroup.Root.
- class (ClassValue): Merged with the base class. Pass framework utility classes here.
- children (Snippet): Content rendered inside the element.
CSS classes: sig-radio-group, sig-radio, sig-radio-dot, sig-radio-label
Data attributes: data-state, data-disabled, data-value

```svelte
<script>
  import { RadioGroup } from 'sigil-ui'
  let plan = $state('free')
</script>

<RadioGroup.Root bind:value={plan}>
  <RadioGroup.Item value="free">Free</RadioGroup.Item>
  <RadioGroup.Item value="pro">Pro</RadioGroup.Item>
</RadioGroup.Root>
```

### Slider

Styled native range input with bindable value and filled track via a --sig-slider-pct custom property.

Props:
- value (number, bindable, default 0): Bindable numeric value.
- min (number, default 0): Minimum.
- max (number, default 100): Maximum.
- step (number, default 1): Step.
- label (string): Accessible label via aria-label.
- class (ClassValue): Merged with the base class. Pass framework utility classes here.
CSS classes: sig-slider
Data attributes: data-disabled

```svelte
<script>
  import { Slider } from 'sigil-ui'
  let volume = $state(40)
</script>

<Slider bind:value={volume} label="Volume" />
```

### Toggle

Pressed/unpressed button with aria-pressed and data-state.

Props:
- pressed (boolean, bindable, default false): Bindable pressed state.
- class (ClassValue): Merged with the base class. Pass framework utility classes here.
- children (Snippet): Content rendered inside the element.
CSS classes: sig-toggle
Data attributes: data-state, data-disabled

```svelte
<script>
  import { Toggle } from 'sigil-ui'
  let bold = $state(false)
</script>

<Toggle bind:pressed={bold} aria-label="Bold">B</Toggle>
```

### Kbd

Keyboard key cap for shortcuts and hints.

Props:
- class (ClassValue): Merged with the base class. Pass framework utility classes here.
- children (Snippet): Content rendered inside the element.
CSS classes: sig-kbd
Data attributes: 

```svelte
<script>
  import { Kbd } from 'sigil-ui'
</script>

<p>Press <Kbd>Ctrl</Kbd> + <Kbd>K</Kbd></p>
```

### Breadcrumb

Breadcrumb namespace: Root renders nav + ol with aria-label, Item renders li with auto slash separators and aria-current on the last entry.

Props:
- label (string, default 'Breadcrumb'): aria-label for the nav landmark on Root.
- current (boolean, default false): Marks the item as the current page via aria-current.
- class (ClassValue): Merged with the base class. Pass framework utility classes here.
- children (Snippet): Content rendered inside the element.
CSS classes: sig-breadcrumb, sig-crumbs, sig-crumb
Data attributes: data-current

```svelte
<script>
  import { Breadcrumb } from 'sigil-ui'
</script>

<Breadcrumb.Root>
  <Breadcrumb.Item><a href="/">Home</a></Breadcrumb.Item>
  <Breadcrumb.Item><a href="/lib">Library</a></Breadcrumb.Item>
  <Breadcrumb.Item current>Current</Breadcrumb.Item>
</Breadcrumb.Root>
```

### Popover

Popover namespace: Root (bindable open), Trigger (aria-haspopup=dialog), Content (anchored, side/align). Outside click and Escape close, focus restored to trigger.

Props:
- open (boolean, bindable, default false): Bindable open state on Popover.Root.
- side ('top' | 'bottom' | 'left' | 'right', default 'bottom'): Side of the trigger on Popover.Content.
- align ('start' | 'center' | 'end', default 'center'): Alignment along the side on Popover.Content.
- class (ClassValue): Merged with the base class. Pass framework utility classes here.
- children (Snippet): Content rendered inside the element.
CSS classes: sig-pop-wrap, sig-pop-trigger, sig-pop-content
Data attributes: data-state, data-side, data-align

```svelte
<script>
  import { Popover, Button } from 'sigil-ui'
</script>

<Popover.Root>
  <Popover.Trigger>Details</Popover.Trigger>
  <Popover.Content side="bottom">Anchored content.</Popover.Content>
</Popover.Root>
```

### DropdownMenu

Menu namespace: Root (bindable open), Trigger (aria-haspopup=menu), Content (role=menu, arrow keys, Home/End), Item (role=menuitem, onSelect), Separator.

Props:
- open (boolean, bindable, default false): Bindable open state on DropdownMenu.Root.
- onSelect (() => void): Called when the item is picked on DropdownMenu.Item.
- side ('top' | 'bottom', default 'bottom'): Side of the trigger on DropdownMenu.Content.
- align ('start' | 'center' | 'end', default 'start'): Alignment on DropdownMenu.Content.
- class (ClassValue): Merged with the base class. Pass framework utility classes here.
- children (Snippet): Content rendered inside the element.
CSS classes: sig-menu-wrap, sig-menu-trigger, sig-menu-content, sig-menu-item, sig-menu-sep
Data attributes: data-state, data-side, data-align, data-disabled

```svelte
<script>
  import { DropdownMenu, Button } from 'sigil-ui'
</script>

<DropdownMenu.Root>
  <DropdownMenu.Trigger>Actions</DropdownMenu.Trigger>
  <DropdownMenu.Content>
    <DropdownMenu.Item onSelect={() => save()}>Save</DropdownMenu.Item>
    <DropdownMenu.Separator />
    <DropdownMenu.Item onSelect={() => remove()}>Delete</DropdownMenu.Item>
  </DropdownMenu.Content>
</DropdownMenu.Root>
```

### Empty

Empty state block with dashed border, optional icon snippet, title, description, and action slot.

Props:
- title (string): Heading line.
- description (string): Secondary line.
- icon (Snippet): Decorative icon, aria-hidden.
- class (ClassValue): Merged with the base class. Pass framework utility classes here.
- children (Snippet): Content rendered inside the element.
CSS classes: sig-empty, sig-empty-icon, sig-empty-title, sig-empty-desc, sig-empty-actions
Data attributes: 

```svelte
<script>
  import { Empty, Button } from 'sigil-ui'
</script>

<Empty title="No results" description="Try a different search.">
  <Button>Clear filters</Button>
</Empty>
```

### Measure

Dev tool: wraps content, shows a live pixel size badge driven by ResizeObserver, and passes width/height to children snippet props.

Props:
- badge (boolean, default true): Show the pixel readout badge.
- decimals (number, default 0): Badge precision.
- class (ClassValue): Merged with the base class. Pass framework utility classes here.
- children (Snippet): Content rendered inside the element.
CSS classes: sig-measure, sig-measure-badge
Data attributes: 

```svelte
<script>
  import { Measure, Card } from 'sigil-ui'
</script>

<Measure>
  <Card.Root>...</Card.Root>
</Measure>
```

### GridOverlay

Dev tool: fixed overlay that draws a spacing grid and can outline elements whose content leaks or clips. Pair with findOverflows() and tagOverflows() from sigil-ui.

Props:
- size (number, default 8): Grid cell size in px.
- overflow (boolean, default false): Outline overflowing elements in danger color.
- interval (number, default 0): Re-scan overflows every N ms. 0 scans once.
- onScan ((issues: OverflowIssue[]) => void): Called after each overflow scan.
- class (ClassValue): Merged with the base class. Pass framework utility classes here.
CSS classes: sig-grid-overlay
Data attributes: data-overflow, data-sig-overflow

```svelte
<script>
  import { GridOverlay } from 'sigil-ui'
  let debug = $state(true)
</script>

{#if debug}
  <GridOverlay size={8} overflow interval={1000} />
{/if}
```

### Spinner

Loading indicator with role=status and an aria-label. Respects prefers-reduced-motion.

Props:
- label (string, default Loading): Accessible name.
- class (ClassValue): Merged with the base class. Pass framework utility classes here.
CSS classes: sig-spinner
Data attributes: 

```svelte
<script>
  import { Spinner } from 'sigil-ui'
</script>

<Spinner />
```

### Loader

Loading indicators in four kinds: spinner, dots, bars and pulse. role=status with an aria-label, three sizes, transform-only animations, respects prefers-reduced-motion.

Props:
- kind ('spinner' | 'dots' | 'bars' | 'pulse', default 'spinner'): Indicator style.
- size ('sm' | 'md' | 'lg', default 'md'): Rendered size.
- label (string, default Loading): Accessible name.
- class (ClassValue): Merged with the base class. Pass framework utility classes here.
CSS classes: sig-loader, sig-loader-dot, sig-loader-bar, sig-loader-pulse
Data attributes: data-kind, data-size

```svelte
<script>
  import { Loader } from 'sigil-ui'
</script>

<Loader kind="dots" />
<Loader kind="bars" size="lg" label="Loading results" />
```

### Waveform

Voice-note style amplitude bars. Data-driven bars prop, or pass live a MediaStream or AnalyserNode for real-time recording meters. Optional played-fraction coloring, playing shimmer, and click or arrow-key seeking through role=slider. Pure CSS, no canvas.

Props:
- bars (number[]): Amplitudes 0-1, one per bar.
- live (MediaStream | AnalyserNode): Real-time source. Streams create and close their own AudioContext.
- barCount (number, default 48): Bars rendered in live mode.
- progress (number): Played fraction 0-1; played bars render in the accent color.
- playing (boolean): Subtle amplitude drift animation.
- onseek ((fraction: number) => void): Enables slider semantics and pointer or keyboard seeking.
- label (string, default Audio waveform): Accessible name.
- height (number, default 48): Rendered height in px.
- class (ClassValue): Merged with the base class. Pass framework utility classes here.
CSS classes: sig-waveform, sig-waveform-bar
Data attributes: data-playing, data-played

```svelte
<script>
  import { Waveform } from 'sigil-ui'
  let progress = $state(0.4)
</script>

<Waveform bars={amps} {progress} playing onseek={(f) => (progress = f)} />
```

### LikeButton

Star or heart reaction button with aria-pressed, an optional count and a transform-only pop animation. liked is bindable.

Props:
- liked (boolean, bindable): Pressed state.
- count (number): Optional count shown beside the icon.
- shape ('heart' | 'star', default 'heart'): Icon shape.
- label (string): Accessible name override.
- class (ClassValue): Merged with the base class. Pass framework utility classes here.
CSS classes: sig-like, sig-like-icon, sig-like-count
Data attributes: data-shape, aria-pressed

```svelte
<script>
  import { LikeButton } from 'sigil-ui'
  let liked = $state(false)
</script>

<LikeButton bind:liked count={128} />
<LikeButton shape="star" bind:liked />
```

### Prose

Long-form typography wrapper. Applies the sig-prose class set from base.css: heading rhythm, lists, blockquotes, tables, figures. size sm or lg scales the type, invert flips colors for dark panels. Requires sigil-ui/base.css.

Props:
- size ('sm' | 'md' | 'lg'): Type scale. Default md applies base styles only.
- invert (boolean): Flip body, muted and border colors for dark panels on a light page.
- class (ClassValue): Merged with the base class. Pass framework utility classes here.
- children (Snippet): Content rendered inside the element.
CSS classes: sig-prose, sig-prose-sm, sig-prose-lg, sig-prose-invert
Data attributes: 

```svelte
<script>
  import 'sigil-ui/base.css'
  import { Prose } from 'sigil-ui'
</script>

<Prose>
  <h1>Release notes</h1>
  <p>Long-form content.</p>
</Prose>
```

### Field

Form field wrapper: label, control, hint and error with generated id, aria-describedby and aria-invalid wiring. The children snippet receives the props to spread on the control.

Props:
- label (string): Label text, bound to the control via for/id.
- hint (string): Help text under the control.
- error (string): Error text; replaces the hint and sets role=alert plus aria-invalid.
- labelProps (HTMLLabelAttributes): Extra props for the label.
- class (ClassValue): Merged with the base class. Pass framework utility classes here.
- children (Snippet): Content rendered inside the element.


### Marquee

Infinite scrolling strip. Content is duplicated for a seamless loop, pauseOnHover freezes it, direction flips it. Honors prefers-reduced-motion.

Props:
- speed (number, default 30): Seconds per loop.
- direction ('left' | 'right', default 'left'): Scroll direction.
- pauseOnHover (boolean, default true): Freeze while hovered.
- class (ClassValue): Merged with the base class. Pass framework utility classes here.
- children (Snippet): Content rendered inside the element.
CSS classes: sig-marquee, sig-marquee-track, sig-marquee-group
Data attributes: data-direction, data-pause

```svelte
<script>
  import { Marquee, Badge } from 'sigil-ui'
</script>

<Marquee>
  <Badge tone="accent">zero deps</Badge>
  <Badge tone="success">runes</Badge>
</Marquee>
```

- --sig-bg: light #ffffff, dark #09090b. Page and surface base
- --sig-fg: light #18181b, dark #fafafa. Primary text
- --sig-muted: light #6d6d76, dark #a1a1aa. Secondary text
- --sig-surface: light #f4f4f5, dark #18181b. Raised fill
- --sig-surface-hover: light #e4e4e7, dark #27272a. Raised fill on hover

- --sig-accent: light #4f46e5, dark #818cf8. Primary accent
- --sig-accent-hover: light #4338ca, dark #6366f1. Accent on hover

- --sig-danger-fg: light #ffffff, dark #09090b. Text on danger

## Adapters

### Tailwind CSS v4 (sigil-ui/tailwind.css)

```
@import 'tailwindcss';
@import 'sigil-ui/tailwind.css';

/* utilities like bg-sig-accent, text-sig-fg, border-sig-border, rounded-sig */
```

### UnoCSS (sigil-ui/uno)

```
import { sigilPreset } from 'sigil-ui/uno'

export default defineConfig({
  presets: [presetWind4(), sigilPreset]
})
```

### Panda CSS (sigil-ui/panda)

```
import { sigilPreset } from 'sigil-ui/panda'

export default defineConfig({
  presets: [sigilPreset]
})
```

### No framework (sigil-ui/theme.css)

```
import 'sigil-ui/theme.css'

/* or override any --sig-* var in your own stylesheet */
```

### sigil css (sigil-ui/css)

```
// sigil.config.mjs
import { defineConfig } from 'sigil-ui/css'

export default defineConfig({
  include: ['./src/**/*.{svelte,ts}'],
  strict: true,
  components: 'auto',
  tokens: { colors: { sig: { accent: 'var(--sig-accent)' } } },
  recipes: { chip: { base: { px: '3' }, variants: { tone: { accent: {} } } } }
})

// npx sigil-ui css --watch      rebuild on change
// npx sigil-ui css --check     CI stale-output guard
// npx sigil-ui css --explain s2abc   class provenance
// components: 'auto' emits styled-system/components.css with only
// the sigil-ui component styles your imports use
// import { css } from '../styled-system/css'
// import { chip } from '../styled-system/recipes'
```


## CLI

npx sigil-ui list | docs <name> | tokens | adapters | manifest | doctor
